docs/configuration.md:code-comment:toml:.translation: Local images, files, and voice messages use base64 by default; for shared file systems, this can be changed to file_uri

docs/configuration.md:code-comment:toml:.translation: Optional: configure context_window or extra_payload for specific models

docs/configuration.md:heading:b148a6c8a3.translation: Environment Variables and Process Environment Inheritance

docs/configuration.md:list:00f41fbcf3739.translation: Atrinis delivery is allowed by default;

docs/configuration.md:list:0391744279d72.source: __ATRIX_CODE_0__ 和单 Atriwisp __ATRIX_CODE_1__ 用于显式禁止平台、私聊或群聊，配置中的 platform-only 表示禁用整个平台所有投递。
docs/configuration.md:list:0391744279d72.translation: __ATRIX_CODE_0__ and single Atriwisp __ATRIX_CODE_1__ are used to explicitly prohibit platforms, private chats, or group chats; `platform-only` in the configuration indicates that all deliveries for the entire platform are disabled.

docs/configuration.md:list:07b59d039ced5.source: __ATRIX_CODE_0__ 和 __ATRIX_CODE_1__ 报告只支持按 Atrinis 裁决后的平台发送给 superadmins，不支持任意 user/group 目标。
docs/configuration.md:list:07b59d039ced5.translation: __ATRIX_CODE_0__ and __ATRIX_CODE_1__ reports only support sending to superadmins via the platform decided by Atrinis, and do not support arbitrary user/group targets.

docs/configuration.md:list:07c5f620a9c45.source: 激活的 tag 会写入 Session metadata，__ATRIX_CODE_0__ 后仍生效。
docs/configuration.md:list:07c5f620a9c45.translation: Activated tags are written to the Session metadata and remain effective after __ATRIX_CODE_0__.

docs/configuration.md:list:08b5846f25c75.source: __ATRIX_CODE_0__：私聊中普通用户当前 Session 的闲置过期时间。
docs/configuration.md:list:08b5846f25c75.translation: __ATRIX_CODE_0__: Idle expiration time of the current Session for ordinary users in private chats.

docs/configuration.md:list:0a7e4b42e26e8.source: __ATRIX_CODE_0__ 时，__ATRIX_CODE_1__ 会启动 CLI WebSocket 服务端。
docs/configuration.md:list:0a7e4b42e26e8.translation: When __ATRIX_CODE_0__, __ATRIX_CODE_1__ will start the CLI WebSocket server.

docs/configuration.md:list:0eac2f410b30b.source: __ATRIX_CODE_0__ 会合并到 LLM 请求 JSON 中，模型级覆盖 Provider 级。
docs/configuration.md:list:0eac2f410b30b.translation: __ATRIX_CODE_0__ will be merged into the LLM request JSON, with model-level settings overriding provider-level settings.

docs/configuration.md:list:134095c072fef.source: 启动连接成功后，ATRI-X 会把内置 slash 命令同步到 Telegram bot 命令菜单；只同步主命令名，不同步 alias。
docs/configuration.md:list:134095c072fef.translation: After the connection is successfully established, ATRI-X will synchronize built-in slash commands to the Telegram bot command menu; only main command names are synchronized, not aliases.

docs/configuration.md:list:14523174ed3c0.source: 文档型 Skill 未写时按 __ATRIX_CODE_0__ 处理。
docs/configuration.md:list:14523174ed3c0.translation: When not specified for a documentation-type Skill, it is handled according to __ATRIX_CODE_0__.

docs/configuration.md:list:15f71d4269e46.source: __ATRIX_CODE_0__ 可选，支持 __ATRIX_CODE_1__ 和 __ATRIX_CODE_2__ 代理地址；
docs/configuration.md:list:15f71d4269e46.translation: __ATRIX_CODE_0__ is optional, supporting __ATRIX_CODE_1__ and __ATRIX_CODE_2__ proxy addresses;

docs/configuration.md:list:1923996de478e.source: __ATRIX_CODE_0__ 指向保存 Bot Token 的环境变量名；也可以用 __ATRIX_CODE_1__ 直接写入配置，但不建议提交真实 token。
docs/configuration.md:list:1923996de478e.translation: __ATRIX_CODE_0__ points to the environment variable name that stores the Bot Token; __ATRIX_CODE_1__ can also be used to write it directly into the configuration, but it is not recommended to commit actual tokens.

docs/configuration.md:list:1b6d163aa65c0.source: __ATRIX_CODE_0__：可选，__ATRIX_CODE_1__ 表示只有 ATRI-X 超级管理员能发现、预载或调用该 Skill。
docs/configuration.md:list:1b6d163aa65c0.translation: __ATRIX_CODE_0__: Optional. __ATRIX_CODE_1__ indicates that only the ATRI-X superadmin can discover, preload, or call this Skill.

docs/configuration.md:list:1c07dd61feb3a.source: __ATRIX_CODE_0__ 是全局回退值，默认 __ATRIX_CODE_1__，模型块里没配 __ATRIX_CODE_2__ 时使用。
docs/configuration.md:list:1c07dd61feb3a.translation: __ATRIX_CODE_0__ is the global fallback value, defaulting to __ATRIX_CODE_1__, and is used when __ATRIX_CODE_2__ is not configured in the model block.

docs/configuration.md:list:204782a729ab7.source: 运行时使用 __ATRIX_CODE_0__ 切换模型后，状态会写回 __ATRIX_CODE_1__。
docs/configuration.md:list:204782a729ab7.translation: After switching models using __ATRIX_CODE_0__ at runtime, the state will be written back to __ATRIX_CODE_1__.

docs/configuration.md:list:215fafde0ee0c.source: __ATRIX_CODE_0__ 是客户端默认连接地址；连接其他机器时在 __ATRIX_CODE_1__ 写远程 WebSocket 地址。
docs/configuration.md:list:215fafde0ee0c.translation: __ATRIX_CODE_0__ is the default client connection address; when connecting to other machines, enter the remote WebSocket address in __ATRIX_CODE_1__.

docs/configuration.md:list:253675af53556.source: 设置为正数时，到时会停止本轮处理并提示用户。
docs/configuration.md:list:253675af53556.translation: When set to a positive number, processing for this round will stop when the time is reached, and the user will be notified.

docs/configuration.md:list:25fcb2b9f63a4.source: 超级管理员的确认阈值由 __ATRIX_CODE_0__ 配置。
docs/configuration.md:list:25fcb2b9f63a4.translation: The confirmation threshold for the superadmin is configured by `__ATRIX_CODE_0__`.

docs/configuration.md:list:2690045a00fb3.source: __ATRIX_CODE_0__：群聊中普通用户当前 Session 的闲置过期时间。
docs/configuration.md:list:2690045a00fb3.translation: __ATRIX_CODE_0__: Idle expiration time of the current Session for ordinary users in group chats.

docs/configuration.md:list:29a04e1e2026e.source: 若平台配置不存在，则自动在平台配置目录生成默认配置文件。
docs/configuration.md:list:29a04e1e2026e.translation: If the platform configuration does not exist, a default configuration file will be automatically generated in the platform configuration directory.

docs/configuration.md:list:2af9cf406d053.source: Atriena 请求中的 __ATRIX_CODE_0__ 进入校验、持久化和执行链路；外部工具名仍需由单个 Atriwisp 的禁用列表控制。
docs/configuration.md:list:2af9cf406d053.translation: __ATRIX_CODE_0__ in Atriena requests enters the validation, persistence, and execution chain; external tool names are still controlled by the denylist of individual Atriwisps.

docs/configuration.md:list:2e202f83cb7bc.source: 改变默认路径或启动行为时同步更新 [快速开始](getting-started.md) 和 README。
docs/configuration.md:list:2e202f83cb7bc.translation: Update [Quick Start](getting-started.md) and README synchronously when changing default paths or startup behavior.

docs/configuration.md:list:2e84e573b27ca.source: __ATRIX_CODE_0__：媒体接收大小上限，默认 100MB；超过上限或无法取得时提示媒体不可用。
docs/configuration.md:list:2e84e573b27ca.translation: __ATRIX_CODE_0__: Maximum media reception size, defaults to 100MB; a prompt indicating that the media is unavailable will be shown if the limit is exceeded or the media cannot be retrieved.

docs/configuration.md:list:3469fdb67b708.source: Atriena 请求可通过 __ATRIX_CODE_0__ 指定，未配置时回退到 __ATRIX_CODE_1__。
docs/configuration.md:list:3469fdb67b708.translation: Atriena requests can be specified via __ATRIX_CODE_0__, falling back to __ATRIX_CODE_1__ when not configured.

docs/configuration.md:list:36265769d44b8.source: prompt 文本从 __ATRIX_CODE_0__ 动态读取；文件变更后影响后续请求，行为类似 __ATRIX_CODE_1__。
docs/configuration.md:list:36265769d44b8.translation: Prompt text is dynamically read from __ATRIX_CODE_0__; changes to the file affect subsequent requests, behaving similarly to __ATRIX_CODE_1__.

docs/configuration.md:list:36fb547c73535.source: 单个 Atriwisp 若配置 __ATRIX_CODE_0__，会覆盖全局默认。
docs/configuration.md:list:36fb547c73535.translation: If a single Atriwisp configures __ATRIX_CODE_0__, it will override the global default.

docs/configuration.md:list:3763c55c68ca1.source: 任一字段设为 __ATRIX_CODE_0__ 表示禁用对应场景的闲置过期。
docs/configuration.md:list:3763c55c68ca1.translation: Setting any field to __ATRIX_CODE_0__ disables idle expiration for the corresponding scenario.

docs/configuration.md:list:38c6f1b32bba4.source: __ATRIX_CODE_0__ 控制流式刷新节流间隔，默认 250ms，避免触发平台限频。
docs/configuration.md:list:38c6f1b32bba4.translation: __ATRIX_CODE_0__ controls the streaming refresh throttle interval, defaulting to 250ms, to avoid triggering platform rate limits.

docs/configuration.md:list:3a7c45f653e61.source: __ATRIX_CODE_0__ 用来配置 __ATRIX_CODE_1__ 可注入的工具组，以及 tag 激活后追加到 system prompt 的工具使用策略。
docs/configuration.md:list:3a7c45f653e61.translation: __ATRIX_CODE_0__ is used to configure the tool groups that can be injected into __ATRIX_CODE_1__, as well as the tool usage strategies appended to the system prompt after a tag is activated.

docs/configuration.md:list:426b41c41c0a8.source: __ATRIX_CODE_0__：工具化时必填，命令数组，不使用 shell 字符串。
docs/configuration.md:list:426b41c41c0a8.translation: __ATRIX_CODE_0__: Required for toolization; a command array, do not use shell strings.

docs/configuration.md:list:43f7fa3931946.source: 平台媒体在实际处理时才下载，不会收到就自动保存到 sandbox。纯文件消息也按平台统一唤醒规则处理。
docs/configuration.md:list:43f7fa3931946.translation: Platform media is only downloaded during actual processing and is not automatically saved to the sandbox upon receipt. Pure file messages are also handled according to the unified platform wake-up rules.

docs/configuration.md:list:447cd7171e49e.source: 重复预载已经存在的工具时不会重复添加，平台会提示 __ATRIX_CODE_0__。
docs/configuration.md:list:447cd7171e49e.translation: When preloading tools that already exist, they will not be added again, and the platform will prompt __ATRIX_CODE_0__.

docs/configuration.md:list:4bcbc0d124768.source: 配置 tag 会追加到内置 tag，不覆盖内置 tag。
docs/configuration.md:list:4bcbc0d124768.translation: Configured tags will be appended to built-in tags, not overwrite them.

docs/configuration.md:list:566bd892d3071.source: 也可以通过 __ATRIX_CODE_0__ 手动压缩当前 Session。
docs/configuration.md:list:566bd892d3071.translation: You can also manually compress the current Session via __ATRIX_CODE_0__.

docs/configuration.md:list:568b3092b2630.source: __ATRIX_CODE_0__ 使用 Provider 的 OpenAI-compatible API 地址。
docs/configuration.md:list:568b3092b2630.translation: __ATRIX_CODE_0__ uses the Provider's OpenAI-compatible API address.

docs/configuration.md:list:572c33982085e.source: __ATRIX_CODE_0__ 填 Telegram 用户 ID 或可直接发送的私聊 chat ID，用于超级管理员权限与通知投递。
docs/configuration.md:list:572c33982085e.translation: Fill __ATRIX_CODE_0__ with a Telegram user ID or a private chat ID that can be sent to directly, used for superadmin permissions and notification delivery.

docs/configuration.md:list:576733f98670b.source: 普通用户只能发现和调用允许风险范围内的工具；工具通过权限校验后，__ATRIX_CODE_0__/__ATRIX_CODE_1__ 风险调用还需要当前用户确认。
docs/configuration.md:list:576733f98670b.translation: Ordinary users can only discover and call tools within the permitted risk range; after a tool passes permission verification, `__ATRIX_CODE_0__`/`__ATRIX_CODE_1__` risk calls still require confirmation by the current user.

docs/configuration.md:list:57ba0c9e8521b.source: __ATRIX_CODE_0__ 的 __ATRIX_CODE_1__ 是全局回退值，默认 __ATRIX_CODE_2__，没有在 __ATRIX_CODE_3__ 里配 __ATRIX_CODE_4__ 时使用。
docs/configuration.md:list:57ba0c9e8521b.translation: __ATRIX_CODE_1__ of __ATRIX_CODE_0__ is the global fallback value, defaulting to __ATRIX_CODE_2__, and is used when __ATRIX_CODE_4__ is not configured in __ATRIX_CODE_3__.

docs/configuration.md:list:5f7cc4d792190.source: __ATRIX_CODE_0__ 模式不注入工具，适合闲聊和低成本对话。
docs/configuration.md:list:5f7cc4d792190.translation: __ATRIX_CODE_0__ mode does not inject tools, making it suitable for casual chatting and low-cost conversations.

docs/configuration.md:list:61a563ce875c4.translation: Existing configurations will not be overwritten.

docs/configuration.md:list:676f82810c89e.source: __ATRIX_CODE_0__ 为特定模型配置 __ATRIX_CODE_1__ 和 __ATRIX_CODE_2__，两者都是可选的。
docs/configuration.md:list:676f82810c89e.translation: __ATRIX_CODE_0__ configures __ATRIX_CODE_1__ and __ATRIX_CODE_2__ for specific models; both are optional.

docs/configuration.md:list:6938cd6fa877f.source: __ATRIX_CODE_0__、__ATRIX_CODE_1__、__ATRIX_CODE_2__ 是 Atrinis LLM 事件可选模型槽位；
docs/configuration.md:list:6938cd6fa877f.translation: __ATRIX_CODE_0__, __ATRIX_CODE_1__, and __ATRIX_CODE_2__ are optional model slots for Atrinis LLM events;

docs/configuration.md:list:6d5facfec0dd3.source: __ATRIX_CODE_0__ 是默认值：使用普通 __ATRIX_CODE_1__ + __ATRIX_CODE_2__，并把常见 Markdown 轻量转换成 Telegram HTML；
docs/configuration.md:list:6d5facfec0dd3.translation: __ATRIX_CODE_0__ is the default value: uses standard __ATRIX_CODE_1__ + __ATRIX_CODE_2__, and performs a lightweight conversion of common Markdown to Telegram HTML;

docs/configuration.md:list:6ee3fa4749d45.source: Atrinis 日志只记录 token name，不记录 token 原文。
docs/configuration.md:list:6ee3fa4749d45.translation: Atrinis logs only record the token name, not the original token text.

docs/configuration.md:list:6fe610b15f454.source: 群聊/超级群组中，命令前缀、触发关键词、__ATRIX_CODE_0__ 或回复 bot 消息都会触发处理。私聊默认处理。
docs/configuration.md:list:6fe610b15f454.translation: In group chats/supergroups, command prefixes, trigger keywords, __ATRIX_CODE_0__, or replying to bot messages will all trigger processing. Private chats are processed by default.

docs/configuration.md:list:70211e47a6888.source: __ATRIX_CODE_0__：定义一个可在聊天里使用的 tag，例如 __ATRIX_CODE_1__ 对应 __ATRIX_CODE_2__ 或简写 __ATRIX_CODE_3__。
docs/configuration.md:list:70211e47a6888.translation: __ATRIX_CODE_0__: Define a tag that can be used in chat, for example, __ATRIX_CODE_1__ corresponds to __ATRIX_CODE_2__ or the shorthand __ATRIX_CODE_3__.

docs/configuration.md:list:749a8c0871a70.source: 自动生成只在没有显式 __ATRIX_CODE_0__ 和 __ATRIX_CODE_1__ 时触发。
docs/configuration.md:list:749a8c0871a70.translation: Automatic generation is only triggered when there are no explicit __ATRIX_CODE_0__ and __ATRIX_CODE_1__.

docs/configuration.md:list:75a4c5af06fd4.source: 单次 LLM 流式请求不受这个字段限制。
docs/configuration.md:list:75a4c5af06fd4.translation: A single LLM streaming request is not limited by this field.

docs/configuration.md:list:75fa2ec7c7c6b.source: 外部工具默认允许；只有单个 Atriwisp 配置 __ATRIX_CODE_0__ 时才禁用指定外部工具。
docs/configuration.md:list:75fa2ec7c7c6b.translation: External tools are allowed by default; specified external tools are only disabled when a single Atriwisp configures __ATRIX_CODE_0__.

docs/configuration.md:list:764e3835feef3.source: __ATRIX_CODE_0__：媒体下载超时，默认 60 秒；Telegram 使用平台 API 超时。
docs/configuration.md:list:764e3835feef3.translation: __ATRIX_CODE_0__: Media download timeout, defaults to 60 seconds; Telegram uses the platform API timeout.

docs/configuration.md:list:779680b70ebde.source: CLI 默认本地用户 __ATRIX_CODE_0__ 是超级管理员。
docs/configuration.md:list:779680b70ebde.translation: The default local CLI user __ATRIX_CODE_0__ is a superadmin.

docs/configuration.md:list:78088abf4da38.source: __ATRIX_CODE_0__：流式过程中两次事件之间的静默上限，默认 60 秒；每收到一个新事件都会重新计时。
docs/configuration.md:list:78088abf4da38.translation: __ATRIX_CODE_0__: The maximum silence duration between two events during streaming, defaulting to 60 seconds; the timer resets upon receiving each new event.

docs/configuration.md:list:782a0b926f2c4.source: __ATRIX_CODE_0__ 指向环境变量名，推荐用这种方式保存密钥。
docs/configuration.md:list:782a0b926f2c4.translation: __ATRIX_CODE_0__ points to an environment variable name; this method is recommended for saving keys.

docs/configuration.md:list:7b3d579013caf.source: __ATRIX_CODE_0__ 和 __ATRIX_CODE_1__ 用于建连或 HTTP 可重试失败，重试延迟按指数退避增长。
docs/configuration.md:list:7b3d579013caf.translation: __ATRIX_CODE_0__ and __ATRIX_CODE_1__ are used for connection failures or retryable HTTP failures, with retry delays increasing via exponential backoff.

docs/configuration.md:list:7b3f6726392d7.source: __ATRIX_CODE_0__ 是手动补充的模型名列表，当 Provider 的模型列表接口获取不到某些模型时使用。
docs/configuration.md:list:7b3f6726392d7.translation: __ATRIX_CODE_0__ is a manually supplemented list of model names, used when the Provider's model list interface cannot retrieve certain models.

docs/configuration.md:list:7c37b94aa52ae.source: 直接 __ATRIX_CODE_0__ 或 __ATRIX_CODE_1__ 只预载指定工具，不激活 tag prompt。
docs/configuration.md:list:7c37b94aa52ae.translation: Directly using __ATRIX_CODE_0__ or __ATRIX_CODE_1__ only preloads the specified tools and does not activate the tag prompt.

docs/configuration.md:list:7cec2ddfce94a.source: __ATRIX_CODE_0__ 使用指定客户端 profile；未指定时使用 __ATRIX_CODE_1__。
docs/configuration.md:list:7cec2ddfce94a.translation: __ATRIX_CODE_0__ uses the specified client profile; if not specified, __ATRIX_CODE_1__ is used.

docs/configuration.md:list:7e11841a85912.source: 未指定或对应槽位未配置时回退到 __ATRIX_CODE_0__ 模型。
docs/configuration.md:list:7e11841a85912.translation: If not specified or if the corresponding slot is not configured, it will fall back to the __ATRIX_CODE_0__ model.

docs/configuration.md:list:7e57e368f35e0.source: __ATRIX_CODE_0__：工具化时必填，JSON object schema，决定 LLM 看到的工具参数。
docs/configuration.md:list:7e57e368f35e0.translation: __ATRIX_CODE_0__: Required for toolization; a JSON object schema that determines the tool parameters seen by the LLM.

docs/configuration.md:list:823651d886728.source: 注册成普通工具时必填。
docs/configuration.md:list:823651d886728.translation: Required when registering as a regular tool.

docs/configuration.md:list:826c019d3d469.source: 用户可编辑配置集中放在平台配置目录，避免直接改源码示例。
docs/configuration.md:list:826c019d3d469.translation: User-editable configurations should be centralized in the platform configuration directory to avoid directly modifying source code examples.

docs/configuration.md:list:8b5d574bc2aa7.source: __ATRIX_CODE_0__ 决定新 Session 默认进入 __ATRIX_CODE_1__ 还是 __ATRIX_CODE_2__。
docs/configuration.md:list:8b5d574bc2aa7.translation: __ATRIX_CODE_0__ determines whether a new Session defaults to __ATRIX_CODE_1__ or __ATRIX_CODE_2__.

docs/configuration.md:list:8e9e8b4b54a13.source: ATRI-X 进程环境：由终端、服务管理器或容器在启动时提供。
docs/configuration.md:list:8e9e8b4b54a13.translation: ATRI-X process environment: provided by the terminal, service manager, or container at startup.

docs/configuration.md:list:8ec0092d2edbe.source: __ATRIX_CODE_0__ 指向保存代理地址的环境变量名；
docs/configuration.md:list:8ec0092d2edbe.translation: __ATRIX_CODE_0__ points to the environment variable name that stores the proxy address;

docs/configuration.md:list:8eda5dd0e26e8.source: 高风险工具确认消息会附带 Telegram inline keyboard，点击按钮会转换为 __ATRIX_CODE_0__、__ATRIX_CODE_1__ 等现有确认命令。
docs/configuration.md:list:8eda5dd0e26e8.translation: Confirmation messages for high-risk tools will be accompanied by a Telegram inline keyboard; clicking buttons will convert them into existing confirmation commands such as __ATRIX_CODE_0__ and __ATRIX_CODE_1__.

docs/configuration.md:list:915198eca61cb.source: 当前支持 __ATRIX_CODE_0__、__ATRIX_CODE_1__ 和 __ATRIX_CODE_2__ 模式；__ATRIX_CODE_3__ 模式使用后台 Session runner 执行。
docs/configuration.md:list:915198eca61cb.translation: Currently, __ATRIX_CODE_0__, __ATRIX_CODE_1__, and __ATRIX_CODE_2__ modes are supported; __ATRIX_CODE_3__ mode is executed using a background Session runner.

docs/configuration.md:list:951c32f987c91.source: 配置根 __ATRIX_CODE_0__：与主配置文件同目录，用于 Provider Key、平台 Secret、CLI/Atrinis token、内置工具变量和 LLM Shell。
docs/configuration.md:list:951c32f987c91.translation: Configuration root __ATRIX_CODE_0__: located in the same directory as the main configuration file, used for Provider Keys, platform Secrets, CLI/Atrinis tokens, built-in tool variables, and LLM Shell.

docs/configuration.md:list:9560ba3ca41db.source: __ATRIX_CODE_0__ 支持写成列表，按顺序尝试多个环境变量名；适合临时切换 token 或做多环境兼容。

docs/configuration.md:list:a2d93e9e23dd1.translation: __ATRIX_CODE_0__ disables formatting and sends only plain text.

docs/configuration.md:list:c9068a05312a3.translation: __ATRIX_CODE_0__: Idle expiration time of the current Session for superadmins in private chats.

docs/configuration.md:list:c931bdd5baa8a.translation: __ATRIX_CODE_0__: an environment layer for individual plugin execs and Workers.

docs/configuration.md:list:c95ef3dd8d5be.translation: When enabled, compaction will be triggered when the Session context approaches the window limit.

docs/configuration.md:list:d7c3bc1bddbe6.translation: Some clients may not be able to view Rich Messages.

docs/configuration.md:list:d8c1371115318.translation: Update this document synchronously when adding new configuration items.

docs/configuration.md:list:de78e104d2e64.translation: This setting applies to both the model list and chat requests.

docs/configuration.md:list:e1359cf53ef87.translation: After successful compaction, it will switch to a new independent Session without modifying the history of the original Session.

docs/configuration.md:list:e19c3d5c92417.source: 也可以用 __ATRIX_CODE_0__ 直接写入配置。
docs/configuration.md:list:e19c3d5c92417.translation: You can also use __ATRIX_CODE_0__ to write the configuration directly.

docs/configuration.md:list:e58bbbb6ee5bb.source: __ATRIX_CODE_0__：这个 tag 成功激活后追加到 system prompt 的工具使用策略。内容会直接给模型看，不会自动添加 tag 名标题。
docs/configuration.md:list:e58bbbb6ee5bb.translation: __ATRIX_CODE_0__: The tool usage strategy appended to the system prompt after this tag is successfully activated. The content will be presented directly to the model without automatically adding a tag name header.

docs/configuration.md:list:ec91021b24aef.source: 只有 __ATRIX_CODE_0__ 或 __ATRIX_CODE_1__ 成功命中至少一个工具后，当前 Session 才会激活该 tag 的 prompt。
docs/configuration.md:list:ec91021b24aef.translation: Only after __ATRIX_CODE_0__ or __ATRIX_CODE_1__ successfully hits at least one tool will the current Session activate the prompt for that tag.

docs/configuration.md:list:eebf0de56f8b3.source: 省略或留空时直连，不继承 ATRI-X 进程的 __ATRIX_CODE_0__、__ATRIX_CODE_1__ 等环境代理。
docs/configuration.md:list:eebf0de56f8b3.translation: When omitted or left blank, it connects directly and does not inherit environment proxies such as __ATRIX_CODE_0__ and __ATRIX_CODE_1__ from the ATRI-X process.

docs/configuration.md:list:f05a0dd91d382.source: __ATRIX_CODE_0__ 是服务端允许登录的 CLI client id 与 token 环境变量列表。
docs/configuration.md:list:f05a0dd91d382.translation: __ATRIX_CODE_0__ is the list of CLI client ID and token environment variables allowed to log in to the server.

docs/configuration.md:list:f188fe00f79cd.source: __ATRIX_CODE_0__ 工具只能访问调用者自己的数据，因此普通用户可以调用；其中 __ATRIX_CODE_1__/__ATRIX_CODE_2__ 风险操作仍需本人确认。
docs/configuration.md:list:f188fe00f79cd.translation: `__ATRIX_CODE_0__` tools can only access the caller's own data, so ordinary users can call them; among these, `__ATRIX_CODE_1__`/`__ATRIX_CODE_2__` risk operations still require confirmation by the user themselves.

docs/configuration.md:list:f333b07e3b4b2.source: __ATRIX_CODE_0__：整轮用户请求总时长上限，从收到用户输入到最终回复结束，默认 0 表示不限时；
docs/configuration.md:list:f333b07e3b4b2.translation: __ATRIX_CODE_0__: The maximum total duration for a round of user requests, from receiving user input to the end of the final response; a default of 0 indicates no time limit;

docs/configuration.md:list:f7fb8ba4217c4.source: __ATRIX_CODE_0__ 是 Atrinis 内部工具白名单；未单独配置的 Atriwisp 继承全局默认。
docs/configuration.md:list:f7fb8ba4217c4.translation: __ATRIX_CODE_0__ is the Atrinis internal tool whitelist; Atriwisps without separate configurations inherit the global default.

docs/configuration.md:list:ff738119c7ed8.source: __ATRIX_CODE_0__：从响应开始到首个流式事件的等待上限，默认 180 秒，适合首字较慢的模型。
docs/configuration.md:list:ff738119c7ed8.translation: __ATRIX_CODE_0__: The maximum wait time from the start of the response to the first streaming event, defaulting to 180 seconds, suitable for models with slower first-token generation.

docs/configuration.md:list:ff92ba8453004.source: 若显式指定的配置路径不存在，ATRI-X 会报错而不是偷偷生成，避免掩盖路径拼写错误。
docs/configuration.md:list:ff92ba8453004.translation: If the explicitly specified configuration path does not exist, ATRI-X will report an error instead of silently generating it, to avoid masking path spelling errors.

docs/configuration.md:paragraph:0783bc28.source: 也可以用 __ATRIX_CODE_0__ 直接写入配置，但不建议提交真实 Secret。
docs/configuration.md:paragraph:0783bc28.translation: You can also use __ATRIX_CODE_0__ to write configurations directly, but it is not recommended to commit actual Secrets.

docs/configuration.md:paragraph:0b9ebd7b.source: normal 是可直接整理的低风险普通记忆，不需要确认；
docs/configuration.md:paragraph:0b9ebd7b.translation: `normal` is low-risk ordinary memory that can be organized directly and does not require confirmation;

docs/configuration.md:paragraph:0d5bfff0.translation: The working directory during execution is fixed to the Skill root directory, and stdout will serve as the tool result;

docs/configuration.md:paragraph:130e7465.source: 若 unit 使用 __ATRIX_CODE_0__ 加载同一文件，则其中的 PATH 必须写成完整值

docs/configuration.md:paragraph:1326f46d.source: 如需使用临时配置文件，也可以显式指定 __ATRIX_CODE_0__。
docs/configuration.md:paragraph:1326f46d.translation: If you need to use a temporary configuration file, you can also explicitly specify __ATRIX_CODE_0__.

If the limit is exceeded, the content will not be read, nor will it be marked as attached; the tool result will indicate that the file needs to be shortened or split before switching the workspace.

docs/configuration.md:paragraph:ddf1b698.source: 更多说明见 [Atrinis 配置与使用](atrinis-usage.md)。
docs/configuration.md:paragraph:ddf1b698.translation: For more information, see [Atrinis Configuration and Usage](atrinis-usage.md).

docs/configuration.md:paragraph:df521571.source: 默认配置下，群聊中的普通用户和超级管理员都会在闲置 10 分钟后开启新 Session；
docs/configuration.md:paragraph:df521571.translation: Under the default configuration, both regular users and superadmins in group chats will start a new Session after being idle for 10 minutes;

docs/configuration.md:paragraph:dfa710d0.source: 后续 __ATRIX_CODE_0__ 只需填写要增加的绝对目录：
docs/configuration.md:paragraph:dfa710d0.translation: For subsequent __ATRIX_CODE_0__, only fill in the absolute directories to be added:

docs/configuration.md:paragraph:dff67f0b.source: __ATRIX_CODE_0__ 分别作为 OneBot 帧写入和 API 响应等待的基础超时。
docs/configuration.md:paragraph:dff67f0b.translation: __ATRIX_CODE_0__ serves as the base timeout for OneBot frame writing and API response waiting, respectively.

docs/configuration.md:paragraph:e4f2cbe7.source: 模型服务通过有效期为 1 小时的预签名 URL 下载对象，不需要另外提供密钥。
docs/configuration.md:paragraph:e4f2cbe7.translation: The model service downloads objects via pre-signed URLs valid for 1 hour, and no additional keys are required.

docs/configuration.md:paragraph:e6ad8597.source: Atrinis 配置建议拆到独立 __ATRIX_CODE_0__，__ATRIX_CODE_1__ 只保留入口路径。
docs/configuration.md:paragraph:e6ad8597.translation: It is recommended to split the Atrinis configuration into a separate __ATRIX_CODE_0__, while __ATRIX_CODE_1__ only retains the entry path.

docs/configuration.md:paragraph:e791009a.source: 实际下载文件的模型服务或中转服务必须能访问该链接。
docs/configuration.md:paragraph:e791009a.translation: The model service or relay service that actually downloads the files must be able to access the link.

docs/configuration.md:paragraph:e9ec1d84.source: 旧版 __ATRIX_CODE_0__ 已移除；已有配置需要改为上述三个新字段。
docs/configuration.md:paragraph:e9ec1d84.translation: The legacy __ATRIX_CODE_0__ has been removed; existing configurations should be updated to the three new fields mentioned above.

docs/configuration.md:paragraph:ebd40254.source: 插件配置固定放在配置目录的 __ATRIX_CODE_0__ 下：
docs/configuration.md:paragraph:ebd40254.translation: Plugin configurations are fixed under __ATRIX_CODE_0__ in the configuration directory:

docs/configuration.md:paragraph:ec34d3b8.source: 切换后，__ATRIX_CODE_0__、__ATRIX_CODE_1__、__ATRIX_CODE_2__ 和前台 __ATRIX_CODE_3__ 等路径类工具会基于该目录解析相对路径，避免每次都传完整路径。
docs/configuration.md:paragraph:ec34d3b8.translation: After switching, path-related tools such as __ATRIX_CODE_0__, __ATRIX_CODE_1__, __ATRIX_CODE_2__, and the foreground __ATRIX_CODE_3__ will resolve relative paths based on this directory, avoiding the need to pass the full path every time.

docs/configuration.md:paragraph:eff1b3a2.source: 未触发的普通群消息仍会写入聊天历史。
docs/configuration.md:paragraph:eff1b3a2.translation: Ordinary group messages that do not trigger a response will still be written to the chat history.

docs/configuration.md:paragraph:f029aa2b.source: 启用时需要补齐平台自己的认证信息和触发关键词。
docs/configuration.md:paragraph:f029aa2b.translation: When enabled, the platform's own authentication information and trigger keywords must be provided.

docs/configuration.md:paragraph:f5f2a4ac.source: 文件格式以 tag 为入口：
docs/configuration.md:paragraph:f5f2a4ac.translation: The file format uses tags as entry points:

docs/configuration.md:paragraph:fa2b9859.source: 这里的基础 PATH 是 ATRI-X 启动时已经获得的进程 PATH；
docs/configuration.md:paragraph:fa2b9859.translation: The base PATH here is the process PATH that ATRI-X has already obtained upon startup;

docs/configuration.md:paragraph:fd160418.source: 若 reload 失败，会恢复原有 TOML，原先没有该文件时则删除本次新建文件。
docs/configuration.md:paragraph:fd160418.translation: If the reload fails, the original TOML will be restored; if the file did not exist previously, the newly created file will be deleted.

docs/configuration.md:paragraph:fe376373.source: Hook 不要直接发平台消息，应返回输出意图，由 Agent 统一交给 Output Manager 发送。
docs/configuration.md:paragraph:fe376373.translation: Hooks should not send platform messages directly; they should return an output intent, which is then handed over to the Output Manager by the Agent for sending.

docs/configuration.md:table:00b5080d70cd.source: Atrinis 监听枢纽配置，保存 HTTP、token、delivery、allowed_tools 和 Atriwisp 策略。
docs/configuration.md:table:00b5080d70cd.translation: Atrinis listening hub configuration, saving HTTP, token, delivery, allowed_tools, and Atriwisp policies.

docs/configuration.md:table:2e381ea7a284.source: ATRI-X 进程环境为基础，配置根 __ATRIX_CODE_0__ 只补充尚不存在的普通变量。
docs/configuration.md:table:2e381ea7a284.translation: Based on the ATRI-X process environment, the configuration root __ATRIX_CODE_0__ only supplements ordinary variables that do not yet exist.

docs/configuration.md:table:3058f980475c.source: 给工具添加 tag 和 prompt 的配置文件。
docs/configuration.md:table:3058f980475c.translation: Configuration file for adding tags and prompts to tools.

docs/configuration.md:table:312d3740a5f5.source: 自动生成的 Hook 公共环境文件；默认只有注释，可补充公共变量和额外 __ATRIX_CODE_0__。
docs/configuration.md:table:312d3740a5f5.translation: Automatically generated Hook public environment file; by default, it contains only comments, but public variables and additional __ATRIX_CODE_0__ can be added.

docs/configuration.md:table:3a03f1cb6734.source: Agent 的 System Prompt 来源文件。
docs/configuration.md:table:3a03f1cb6734.translation: The System Prompt source file for the Agent.

docs/configuration.md:table:4dc9aa3e26ab.source: 长期记忆 Markdown 源数据目录，默认位于配置目录下。
docs/configuration.md:table:4dc9aa3e26ab.translation: Long-term memory Markdown source data directory, located in the configuration directory by default.

docs/configuration.md:table:518b5966b624.source: AgentSkill 可在根目录放置 __ATRIX_CODE_0__ 配置可见性或注册为普通工具。
docs/configuration.md:table:518b5966b624.translation: AgentSkill can place __ATRIX_CODE_0__ in the root directory to configure visibility or register as a regular tool.

docs/configuration.md:table:5392c14a64df.source: 常驻记忆文件，默认位于配置目录下。
docs/configuration.md:table:5392c14a64df.translation: Resident memory file, located in the configuration directory by default.

docs/configuration.md:table:735a88422174.source: 用户侧 Skill 目录，默认位于配置目录下；
docs/configuration.md:table:735a88422174.translation: User-side Skill directory, located in the configuration directory by default;

docs/configuration.md:table:a8fbaaa89023.source: 内置工具与 Go Skill（含 LLM Shell）
docs/configuration.md:table:a8fbaaa89023.translation: Built-in tools and Go Skills (including LLM Shell)

docs/configuration.md:table:b7d433d09513.source: ATRI-X 进程环境为基础，__ATRIX_CODE_0__ 覆盖同名普通变量。
docs/configuration.md:table:b7d433d09513.translation: Based on the ATRI-X process environment, __ATRIX_CODE_0__ overrides ordinary variables with the same name.

docs/configuration.md:table:c3f46fad0461.source: 运行态状态，例如默认 Session 模式、chat/work/compact/naming 模型选择。
docs/configuration.md:table:c3f46fad0461.translation: Runtime state, e.g., default Session mode, chat/work/compact/naming model selection.

docs/configuration.md:table:ca835effca85.source: 可选，本地密钥文件，不建议提交；首次自动生成的是 __ATRIX_CODE_0__，不会直接生成 __ATRIX_CODE_1__。
docs/configuration.md:table:ca835effca85.translation: Optional, local key file, not recommended for submission; the one automatically generated the first time is __ATRIX_CODE_0__, and __ATRIX_CODE_1__ will not be generated directly.

docs/configuration.md:table:f14e5e3a3992.source: 根 Hook 环境为基础，插件配置文件同目录的 __ATRIX_CODE_0__ 再覆盖同名普通变量。
docs/configuration.md:table:f14e5e3a3992.translation: Based on the root Hook environment, the __ATRIX_CODE_0__ in the same directory as the plugin configuration file further overrides ordinary variables with the same name.
